dorkQueries.title: Dork Queries
dorkQueries.description: Google dork queries to run. Examples: site:linkedin.com/in data scientist, filetype:pdf intitle:resume, inurl:admin intitle:login. One per line.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max Pages Per Query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: SERP pages to walk per dork (10 organic results per page). Google throttles deep pagination — 3-5 is a safe default.

maxResults.title: Max Results (total)
maxResults.description: Global cap across all dorks. Actor stops early once reached.

hl.title: Interface Language (hl)
hl.description: Google hl parameter, e.g. en, de, fr.

gl.title: Geo Location (gl)
gl.description: Google gl parameter (country code), e.g. us, gb, de. Affects ranking/localization.

delaySec.title: Delay Between Pages (sec)
delaySec.description: Politeness pause between SERP pages. Increase to 4-6s if you hit 'unusual traffic' blocks.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Strongly recommended: enable Apify Proxy with RESIDENTIAL group for Google. Datacenter IPs are blocked within a few requests.
